Figure 1: Five-layer reference architecture composing all seven ontology-aware design patterns. Solid arrows indicate primary data flow from ingestion through training. Dashed arrows indicate cross-cutting concerns: the Drift Sentinel monitors all layers, the Regulatory Compliance Adapter wraps all external-facing operations, and the feedback path (monitored by the Reification Circuit Breaker) connects model outputs back to data ingestion.
